description: Searches Pexels stock photos (API: https://www.pexels.com/api/documentation/) by short English subject queries. Each photo includes hotlinkable URLs at several sizes, a `sizes` map with each variant's pixel dimensions, `avg_color`, and the photographer's name and attribution URL; the response also includes a `size_guide` mapping slot widths to variants (hero/banner ~940–1880px → large/large2x, card ~350px → medium, avatar → tiny). `queries: [...]` runs several searches in parallel and returns { queries: { [q]: result } } — `pick:'best'` (default) keeps only the top photo per query, `pick:'all'` the full list; `query` runs a single search. Works without configuration through a shared hosted proxy; a PEXELS_API_KEY env var or x-pexels-key header uses a personal Pexels quota.

color.description: Optional color filter: a name (red, blue, …) or a hex like '6a8f3c'.

orientation.description: Preferred shape — 'landscape' for heroes/banners, 'portrait' for tall cards, 'square' for icons/avatars.

pick.description: With `queries`, 'best' (default) returns only the top photo per query (compact, drop-in for specials.src); 'all' returns the full result. Single-query calls always return the full result.

queries.description: Several subject queries (typically one per image slot), run in parallel in one call.

query.description: Single subject query; returns the full result.

size.description: Minimum photo size to return (default any).

name: search_images
